title: sfo exchange: one line of plan.jsonl
description: An action of a plan of the job with its state, as 'sfo plan show' lists it and 'sfo export --format jsonl' writes it. Since format 1.1.

plan_id.description: The plan, listed in 'plans' of job.json.

id.description: Id of the action, as 'sfo plan show' and 'sfo plan approve --action' name it.

finding_key.description: Key of the finding in findings.jsonl the action comes from.

unit.description: The title of the finding: what and where, in one line.

relative_path.description: The file or folder relative to the job root, with '/'.

file_id.description: For a file action: its id in files.jsonl.

directory_id.description: For a folder action: its id in directories.jsonl.

recommended.description: What the finding recommended; differs from kind when a check turned it into leave.

target_path.description: Full path at the target; for delete_source the place in the library that already holds the content.

library_job_id.description: The library job whose root holds target_path.

note.description: What a person should know: why the kind became leave, that the content is in a library already.

sensitive.description: The source is marked sensitive; decided one by one.

decided_by.description: human or agent: who confirmed or rejected it last.

oneOf.description: Files worth keeping whose content is not in the library. Needs a comparison with a library.
Files worth keeping in a place without value: app data, a program folder, a mixed or disposable folder.
Files whose kind does not fit the purpose of their folder, with a proposed place when there is a library.
Files or skipped folders marked sensitive. Always decided one by one; never removed on their own.
Files with exactly the same content at several places of the source.
One file.
A whole folder with everything below it; its name stays.
Copy to the target, verify, then remove the original.
Copy to the target; the original stays.
Move to a quarantine folder from which it can be restored.
Remove the original, because the same content is already in the library.

Clutter: the original goes into the hold folder of its source and nothing is copied anywhere (https://github.com/crack666/smart_file_organizer/issues/105). Needs neither target nor library; taken back by 'sfo plan undo', removed for good only by 'sfo plan purge'. Never recommended by a finding.
Leave the file where it is.
The rules of 'sfo plan create', from accepted findings and stored decisions.
A model answer taken over as it was.
A steering agent through 'sfo plan set' or 'sfo plan import' with '--by agent'.
A person.
Proposed and not confirmed; also after every change of kind, target or reason.
Confirmed by a person or a steering agent; only an action without problems can be confirmed.
Not wanted; it is not executed.

The first step of the execution is done: the copy at the target is written and checked by its full checksum (for 'delete_source': the copy in the library is checked), and the original waits for the second, separately confirmed step that removes it.
Carried out by the execution step.
The execution step tried and stopped; the original stays.
Carried out and taken back.
